notes.title: A little update
notes.content:
Fix panel: Instead of the fill bar -> load value in percent. (Depending on the complexity).

 You can now safely close this panel when fixing any components that are broken, and fixing components will self-fill.

 Camera panel: Now you can see the audio system reboot. (Depending on the complexity).

 When you use the Use Audio button, you will see the number of how long you need to wait to use the button again.


If you notice any bug, go to my Discord server: https://discord.gg/Zfcf2a7M

Under SUPPORT -> #support-fnast.

Have a good game)
